<div class="card-body">
'''Obi-Wan Kenobi''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4065). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オビ=ワン・ケノービ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘開始時から参加していたら、１フォース消費して、能力値＝１の相手のキャラクターを一人選び、移動を強要する（移動コストなし）。移動しなかったら、そのキャラクターを直ちにロストデッキへ置く。耐：損耗＜５。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-obi-wan-kenobi-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジェダイの騎士。ヨーダの教えを受けた。ベイル・オーガナの友人。ケノービ将軍はクローン大戦時に旧共和国軍の英雄となった。アナキンとルーク・スカイウォーカーの導師。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Obi-Wan Kenobi.

'''Card text:''' If he has participated since the start of a battle, use 1 Force to select an opposing character with ability 1 and force it to move at no movement cost. If it does not move, place it in the Lost Pile immediately. Immune to attrition less than 5.

'''Lore:''' A Jedi Knight taught by Yoda and a friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic's military during the Clone Wars. Mentor to Anakin and [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]].
